faqs.q: Sec. 102-406. - Lead drinking water service line replacement responsibilities.
faqs.a:
(a)
The city shall be responsible for replacement of the system-owned portion of any LSL
               and lead connectors between the water main and the meter.
(b)
The property owner shall be responsible for the replacement of the customer-owned
               portion of an LSL from the meter to the property point of entry, in compliance with
               the engineering standards.
(c)
The material used in service lines must be investigated to determine whether the service
               lines are lead or non-lead. Service lines that have not been verified as lead or non-lead,
               will be treated as LSL under this article.
(d)
From May 1, 2024, to December 31, 2026, with consent from the property owner, the
               city will replace the customer-owned portion of an LSL from the meter to the property
               point of entry, according to the Lead Service Line Replacement Program protocols.
(e)
The division of responsibilities between the city and a property owner in this section
               shall apply only to replacement of an LSL. Repair and replacement of service lines
               in all other circumstances shall be governed by the engineering standards. Premise
               plumbing replacement is not applicable to this article and remains the responsibility
               of the property owner.
(f)
All LSL replacements must be performed according to the engineering standards.
(
Ord. No. 4869
, § 1, 3-4-2024)
